breed.appearance: A young kitten with a short, soft coat in a silver-gray to brownish-gray base covered in dense black mackerel tabby stripes, with a bold 'M' on the forehead, dark lines running from the outer eye corners across the cheeks, and darker banding along the back and legs. She has large, upright, slightly oversized ears with pinkish inner skin and light tufts, big round pale green-gold eyes, a small pink nose outlined in dark rims, a creamy-white muzzle and chin, and long white whiskers. She has a slim, lanky kitten build and wears a bright green breakaway collar.
breed.fun_fact: Mackerel tabbies get their name from their fish-skeleton-like stripes, and every tabby wears a signature 'M' on its forehead like a built-in name tag!
